privateProjects.calorie-description: A calorie diary PWA: estimates calories and macros of a meal from a photo or a text description using the Claude API. Entries are stored locally on the device; the app installs on a phone like a native one. A minimal Express proxy keeps the API key on the server. Deployed on a VPS (nginx + PM2) with a site-wide login.
privateProjects.files-description: A personal Dropbox-style file service for my family. The NestJS backend issues presigned S3 URLs, so files travel between the browser and S3 directly and are never proxied through the API; PostgreSQL keeps metadata only. JWT auth with refresh-token rotation, per-user storage quotas, i18n, allowlist-only registration.
